[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T15:31:39Z, by staff] Sanofi Initiates Phase 3 Trial for Influenza-COVID-19 Combination Vaccine
Sanofi has commenced a Phase 3 clinical trial in Europe for its influenza-COVID-19 combination vaccine candidate, triggering a $125 million milestone payment to its partner, Novavax.
Sanofi has initiated a Phase 3 clinical trial in Europe to evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of a combination vaccine candidate that pairs its high-dose influenza vaccine (Efluelda/Fluzone High-Dose) with Novavax's Nuvaxovid COVID-19 vaccine. The trial focuses on adults aged 60 and older. The initiation of this study, marked by the dosing of the fifth patient, triggered a $125 million milestone payment from Sanofi to Novavax under their existing collaboration and license agreement. Sanofi aims to be a first mover in the combination vaccine segment, which addresses a global market valued at over $10 billion. The partnership has already generated over $1 billion in revenue for Novavax to date.
